import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    titles = data[2:]
    
    # Create a list of tuples (index, title)
    indexed_titles = list(enumerate(titles, start=1))
    
    # Sort the list based on the custom asc-desc-ending order
    indexed_titles.sort(key=lambda x: [(ord(c) if i % 2 else -ord(c)) for i, c in enumerate(x[1])])
    
    # Extract the sorted indices
    sorted_indices = [index for index, title in indexed_titles]
    
    # Print the sorted indices
    print(" ".join(map(str, sorted_indices)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
